# Vadiya Impex

> Timber merchant and importer/exporter based in Gandhidham, Gujarat, with additional branches in Bangalore, Karnataka. Specializing in premium teak, architectural hardwoods, and custom timber solutions.

## Pages

- [Home](https://vadiyaimpex.com/): Overview of Vadiya Impex and our branches
- [Services](https://vadiyaimpex.com/services): Timber import, milling, seasoning, and architectural timber services
- [Our Work](https://vadiyaimpex.com/our-work): Portfolio of completed projects
- [Contact](https://vadiyaimpex.com/contact): Contact information for all branches
- [Gandhidham Branch](https://vadiyaimpex.com/store/gandhidham)
- [Bangalore North Branch](https://vadiyaimpex.com/store/bangalore-1)
- [Bangalore South Branch](https://vadiyaimpex.com/store/bangalore-2)
